local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local character, humanoid, root
local animTrackConnection, diedConnection

local function stopAllAnimations()
    if humanoid then
        for _, track in pairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            track:Stop(0)
        end
    end
end

local function resetJoints()
    if character then
        for _, v in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            -- تجنب تعديل مفاصل الأدوات لضمان عملها بشكل طبيعي أثناء الطيران

            end
        end
    end
end

local flying = false
local flySpeed = 1
local bv, bg

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if bv then bv:Destroy(); bv = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy(); bg = nil end
    if animTrackConnection then animTrackConnection:Disconnect(); animTrackConnection = nil end
    
    if humanoid then

    if mainGui then

        end
    end
end

local function updateVars(newChar)
    stopFly()
    character = newChar
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if diedConnection then diedConnection:Disconnect() end
    diedConnection = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        stopFly()
    end)

if LocalPlayer.Character then updateVars(LocalPlayer.Character) end

main.ResetOnSpawn = false

        bp.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)

    end

    if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
end

onof.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

    keybindBtn.Text = "chng key:"
    keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
end

keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startKeyListening)

    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end

    if listeningForKey then
        if not blockedKeys[input.KeyCode] then
            flyKey = input.KeyCode
            keybindBtn.Text = "key " .. input.KeyCode.Name
            listeningForKey = false
            keybindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
        end
        return
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F1 then
        startKeyListening()
        return
    end

    if gameProcessed then return end

    if flyKey and input.KeyCode == flyKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

            stopTime = os.clock()

            if adminEnabled then
                local elapsed = os.clock() - stopTime
                local glideDuration = 0.4
                
                if elapsed < glideDuration then
                    local alpha = 1 - (elapsed / glideDuration)
                    currentVelocity = lastMoveDir * (alpha * alpha)
                else
                    currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
            else
                currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
        end
        
        bv.Velocity = currentVelocity
        if bg then bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame end
        if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
    end
end)

    mini.Text = isMini and "+" or "-"
end)

local function invoke(remote,timeout,...)
    if not alive() then

    end

    RequestId -= 1

    local id = RequestId
    local finished = false
    local status
    local result
    local connection

    connection =
        remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(
            responseId,
            responseStatus,
            responseResult
        )
            if not alive() then
                return
            end

            if responseId ~= id then
                return
            end

            status = responseStatus
            result = responseResult
            finished = true
        end)

    local args = table.pack(...)

    local fired = pcall(function()
        remote:FireServer(
            id,
            table.unpack(args,1,args.n)
        )
    end)

    if not fired then
        connection:Disconnect()
        return false,nil
    end

    local started = os.clock()

    while not finished
        and alive()
        and os.clock() - started < (timeout or 5) do

        task.wait()
    end

    connection:Disconnect()

    if not alive() or not finished then
        return false,nil
    end

    if status ~= true then
        return false,result
    end

    return true,result
end

local function parseMoney(text)
    if type(text) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end

    local clean =
        text:gsub(",","")
        :gsub("¢","")
        :gsub("%$","")
        :gsub("%s+","")

    local number,suffix =
        clean:match(
            "([%d%.]+)([%a]*)"
        )

    number = tonumber(number)

    if not number then
        return nil
    end

    suffix =
        string.lower(
            suffix or ""
        )

    local mult = {
        [""] = 1,
        k = 1e3,
        m = 1e6,
        b = 1e9,
        t = 1e12,
        qa = 1e15,
        qi = 1e18,
        sx = 1e21,
        sp = 1e24,
        oc = 1e27,
        no = 1e30,
        dc = 1e33
    }

    return
        number
        * (
            mult[suffix]
            or 1
        )
end

local function findPrompt(object,words)
    if not object then

    end

    local fallback

    for _,descendant in ipairs(
        object:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if descendant:IsA(
            "ProximityPrompt"
        ) then

            fallback =
                fallback or descendant

            local text =
                string.lower(
                    tostring(
                        descendant.ActionText
                    )
                    .. " "
                    .. tostring(
                        descendant.ObjectText
                    )
                    .. " "
                    .. descendant.Name
                )

            for _,word in ipairs(
                words or {}
            ) do
                if string.find(
                    text,
                    string.lower(word),
                    1,
                    true
                ) then

                    return descendant
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return fallback
end

local function triggerPrompt(prompt)
    if not prompt then
        return false

    if Caps.FirePrompt then
        local success =
            pcall(function()
                fireproximityprompt(
                    prompt
                )
            end)

        if success then
            task.wait(0.1)

            return true
        end
    end

    local duration =
        math.max(
            prompt.HoldDuration,
            0.05
        )

    local success =
        pcall(function()
            prompt:InputHoldBegin()

            task.wait(
                duration + 0.08
            )

            prompt:InputHoldEnd()
        end)

    if success then
        task.wait(0.1)

        return true
    end

    local key =
        prompt.KeyboardKeyCode

    if key == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
        key = Enum.KeyCode.E
    end

    success =
        pcall(function()
            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(
                true,
                key,
                false,
                game
            )

            task.wait(
                duration + 0.08
            )

            VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(
                false,
                key,
                false,
                game
            )
        end)

    task.wait(0.1)

    return success
end

local function sellUid(uid)
    if not uid then
        return false,"missing uid"
    end

    local item =
        findInventory(
            uid,
            refreshData()
        )

    if not item then
        return true,"gone"
    end

    if item.favorited == true then
        return false,"favorited"
    end

    if item.pedestalSlot ~= nil then
        return false,"displayed"
    end

    unequipTools()

    if not equipUid(uid) then
        return false,"equip failed"
    end

    local seller =
        getSeller()

    if not seller then
        return false,"seller missing"
    end

    teleportNear(
        seller,
        3
    )

    task.wait(0.09)

    for attempt = 1,3 do
        if not equipUid(uid) then
            task.wait(0.1)
            continue
        end

        local success,result =
            invoke(
                SellHeldRemote,
                3
            )

        task.wait(0.1)

        if not itemStillExists(uid) then
            resetDigEquipment()

            return true,"sold"
        end

        if result == "favorited" then
            resetDigEquipment()

            return false,"favorited"
        end

        if attempt < 3 then
            teleportNear(
                seller,
                3
            )

            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end

    resetDigEquipment()

    return false,"sell failed"
end

local function manageItem(uid,force)
    local allowPlace =
        force
        or Settings.AutoPlace

    local allowSell =
        force
        or Settings.AutoSell

    local returnPosition =
        savePosition()

    local item =
        findInventory(
            uid,
            refreshData()
        )

    if not item
        or item.dirty == true then

        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        return false
    end

    local newValue =
        valueFromEntry(item)

    local open =
        getOpenPedestal()

    if open then
        if allowPlace then
            local success =
                placeUid(
                    open,
                    uid
                )

            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            if success then
                notify(
                    "Item Logic",
                    "Placed in open slot"
                )
            end

            return success

        elseif allowSell then
            local success,reason =
                sellUid(uid)

            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            if not success then
                notify(
                    "Item Logic",
                    "Sell failed: "
                    .. tostring(reason)
                )
            end

            return success

        else
            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            return true
        end
    end

    local weakest,weakestValue =
        weakestPedestal()

    if not weakest
        or newValue <= 0
        or newValue <= weakestValue then

        if allowSell then
            local success,reason =
                sellUid(uid)

            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            if not success then
                notify(
                    "Item Logic",
                    "Sell failed: "
                    .. tostring(reason)
                )
            end

            return success
        end

        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        resetDigEquipment()

        return true
    end

    if not allowPlace then
        if allowSell then
            local success,reason =
                sellUid(uid)

            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            if not success then
                notify(
                    "Item Logic",
                    "Sell failed: "
                    .. tostring(reason)
                )
            end

            return success
        end

        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        resetDigEquipment()

        return true
    end

    local oldUid =
        weakest:GetAttribute(
            "ItemUid"
        )

    local oldSlot =
        weakest:GetAttribute(
            "Slot"
        )

    local picked =
        pickupPedestal(
            weakest
        )

    if picked ~= oldUid then
        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        resetDigEquipment()

        notify(
            "Item Logic",
            "Pickup failed"
        )

        return false
    end

    task.wait(0.08)

    if allowSell then
        local soldOld,reason =
            sellUid(oldUid)

        if not soldOld then
            local original =
                findPedestalBySlot(
                    oldSlot
                )

            if original then
                placeUid(
                    original,
                    oldUid
                )
            end

            restorePosition(
                returnPosition
            )

            resetDigEquipment()

            notify(
                "Item Logic",
                "Old sale failed: "
                .. tostring(reason)
            )

            return false
        end
    end

    task.wait(0.06)

    local target =
        findPedestalBySlot(
            oldSlot
        )

    local placed =
        target
        and placeUid(
            target,
            uid
        )

    restorePosition(
        returnPosition
    )

    resetDigEquipment()

    if placed then
        if allowSell then
            notify(
                "Item Logic",
                "Replaced weaker item"
            )
        else
            notify(
                "Item Logic",
                "Replaced item; old item kept in inventory"
            )
        end
    end

    return placed == true
end

local function instantClean(
    item,
    manageAfter,
    forceManage
)
    if not item or not item.uid then
        return false
    end

    local uid = item.uid

    local returnPosition =
        savePosition()

    local bench =
        getWorkbench()

    if bench then
        teleportTo(bench)

        task.wait(0.08)
    end

    unequipTools()

    if not equipUid(uid) then
        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        resetDigEquipment()

        return false
    end

    local success,result =
        invoke(
            BeginCleaningRemote,
            4,
            uid
        )

    if not success then
        restorePosition(
            returnPosition
        )

        resetDigEquipment()

        return false
    end

    if type(result) == "number" then
        KnownValues[uid] = result

    elseif type(result) == "table" then
        for _,key in ipairs({
            "value",
            "Value",
            "sellValue",
            "SellValue",
            "worth",
            "Worth"
        }) do
            if type(result[key]) == "number" then
                KnownValues[uid] =
                    result[key]

                break
            end
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        SaveCleanProgressRemote:FireServer(
            uid,
            FULL_CLEAN_MASK
        )
    end)

    task.wait(0.03)

    pcall(function()
        FinishCleaningRemote:FireServer(
            uid
        )
    end)

    local cleaned = false
    local started = os.clock()

    repeat
        local updated =
            findInventory(
                uid,
                refreshData()
            )

        if updated
            and updated.dirty == false then

            cleaned = true
            break
        end

        task.wait(0.04)

    until not alive()
        or os.clock() - started > 1.3

    restorePosition(
        returnPosition
    )

    resetDigEquipment()

    if cleaned
        and manageAfter then

        manageItem(
            uid,
            forceManage
        )
    end

    NextSearch =
        os.clock() + 0.1

    return cleaned
end

local function bestAffordableGear(
    list,
    data,
    ownedKey,
    equippedKey
)
    if not data then
        return nil
    end

    local money =
        tonumber(data.Gold)
        or 0

    local current =
        findDefinition(
            list,
            data[equippedKey]
        )

    local bestScore =
        current
        and current[4]
        or 0

    local best

    for _,gear in ipairs(list) do
        if gear[3] > 0
            and gear[3] <= money
            and gear[4] > bestScore
            and islandUnlocked(
                data,
                gear[5]
            )
            and not gearOwned(
                data,
                ownedKey,
                gear[1]
            ) then

            best = gear
            bestScore = gear[4]
        end
    end

    return best
end

local ShopCache = {}

local function findShopModel(
    gear,
    folderName
)
    local key =
        folderName
        .. ":"
        .. gear[1]

    local cached =
        ShopCache[key]

    if cached
        and cached.Parent then

        return cached
    end

    for _,object in ipairs(
        workspace:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if object:IsA("Model")
            and object.Name == gear[2] then

            local ancestor =
                object.Parent

            while ancestor
                and ancestor ~= workspace do

                if ancestor.Name == folderName then
                    ShopCache[key] = object

                    return object
                end

                ancestor =
                    ancestor.Parent
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function autoBuyGear(
    category,
    list,
    ownedKey,
    equippedKey,
    shopFolder
)
    local data =
        refreshData()

    if not data then
        return false
    end

    local current =
        findDefinition(
            list,
            data[equippedKey]
        )

    local ownedBest =
        bestOwnedGear(
            list,
            data,
            ownedKey
        )

    if ownedBest
        and (
            not current
            or ownedBest[4] > current[4]
        ) then

        local success =
            invoke(
                EquipGearRemote,
                3,
                category,
                ownedBest[1]
            )

        refreshData()

        resetDigEquipment()

        return success == true
    end

    local gear =
        bestAffordableGear(
            list,
            data,
            ownedKey,
            equippedKey
        )

    if not gear then
        return false
    end

    local returnPosition =
        savePosition()

    local shop =
        findShopModel(
            gear,
            shopFolder
        )

    if shop then
        teleportTo(shop)

        task.wait(0.07)
    end

    local success,bought =
        invoke(
            BuyGearRemote,
            4,
            category,
            gear[1]
        )

    if success
        and bought == true then

        task.wait(0.04)

        invoke(
            EquipGearRemote,
            3,
            category,
            gear[1]
        )

        refreshData()
    end

    restorePosition(
        returnPosition
    )

    resetDigEquipment()

    return
        success
        and bought == true
end

local function isDigAreaPart(object)
    return
        object:IsA("BasePart")
        and object.Name == "DigArea"
end

local function invalidateIsland(island)
    IslandProfiles[island] = nil
    IslandStates[island] = nil
end

local function buildIslandProfile(island)
    local parts = {}

    if not island
        or not island.Parent then

        return {
            Island = island,
            Parts = parts,
            Mode = "None"
        }
    end

    for _,object in ipairs(
        island:GetDescendants()
    ) do
        if isDigAreaPart(object) then
            local ancestor =
                object.Parent

            local valid =
                object.Parent
                and object.Parent.Name
                == "DigAreas"

            while not valid
                and ancestor
                and ancestor ~= island do

                if ancestor.Name == "DigAreas" then
                    valid = true
                    break
                end

                ancestor =
                    ancestor.Parent
            end

            if valid then
                table.insert(
                    parts,
                    object
                )
            end
        end
    end

    table.sort(
        parts,
        function(a,b)
            return
                a:GetFullName()
                <
                b:GetFullName()
        end
    )

    return {
        Island = island,

        Parts = parts,

        Mode =
            #parts >= 4
            and "Hotspots"
            or "Zone"
    }
end

local function getIslandProfile(island)
    local cached =
        IslandProfiles[island]

    if cached then
        local valid = true

        for _,part in ipairs(
            cached.Parts
        ) do
            if not part.Parent then
                valid = false
                break
            end
        end

        if valid then
            return cached
        end
    end

    local profile =
        buildIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    IslandProfiles[island] =
        profile

    return profile
end

local function getIslandState(island)
    if not IslandStates[island] then
        IslandStates[island] = {
            Cursor = 0,
            FailedParts = {}
        }
    end

    return IslandStates[island]
end

local function insidePart(
    part,
    position,
    padding
)
    local point =
        part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(
            position
        )

    padding = padding or 0

    return
        math.abs(point.X)
        <= part.Size.X / 2 + padding
        and
        math.abs(point.Z)
        <= part.Size.Z / 2 + padding
end

local function getRaycastIgnore(
    island,
    profile
)
    local ignore = {}

    local char = character()

    if char then
        table.insert(
            ignore,
            char
        )
    end

    profile =
        profile
        or getIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        table.insert(
            ignore,
            part
        )
    end

    return ignore
end

local function groundAt(
    island,
    position,
    profile
)
    local params =
        RaycastParams.new()

    params.FilterType =
        Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    params.IgnoreWater = false

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances =
        getRaycastIgnore(
            island,
            profile
        )

    return workspace:Raycast(
        position
        + Vector3.new(
            0,
            65,
            0
        ),

        Vector3.new(
            0,
            -200,
            0
        ),

        params
    )
end

local function teleportGround(
    island,
    position,
    profile
)
    if isDigging() then
        return false
    end

    local hrp = root()
    local hum = humanoid()

    if not hrp or not hum then
        return false
    end

    local result =
        groundAt(
            island,
            position,
            profile
        )

    if not result then
        return false
    end

    local offset =
        hum.HipHeight
        + hrp.Size.Y / 2
        + 0.02

    hrp.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(
            result.Position
            + Vector3.new(
                0,
                offset,
                0
            )
        )
        * hrp.CFrame.Rotation

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
        Vector3.zero

    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
        Vector3.zero

    return true
end

local function randomPointInPart(
    part,
    inset
)
    inset = inset or 0.15

    local halfX =
        math.max(
            0,
            part.Size.X
            * 0.5
            * (1 - inset)
        )

    local halfZ =
        math.max(
            0,
            part.Size.Z
            * 0.5
            * (1 - inset)
        )

    local x =
        halfX > 0.5
        and RNG:NextNumber(
            -halfX,
            halfX
        )
        or 0

    local z =
        halfZ > 0.5
        and RNG:NextNumber(
            -halfZ,
            halfZ
        )
        or 0

    return
        part.CFrame
        * Vector3.new(
            x,
            0,
            z
        )
end

local function getNearestNodeForProfile(
    profile
)
    local hrp = root()

    if not hrp then
        return nil
    end

    local best
    local bestDistance = math.huge
    local now = os.clock()

    for id,node in pairs(
        BuriedNodes
    ) do
        if type(node) == "table"
            and typeof(node.position)
            == "Vector3" then

            local valid = false

            for _,part in ipairs(
                profile.Parts
            ) do
                if insidePart(
                    part,
                    node.position,
                    4
                ) then

                    valid = true
                    break
                end
            end

            if valid then
                local failed =
                    FailedNodes[id]

                if not failed
                    or now >= failed then

                    local distance =
                        (
                            hrp.Position
                            - node.position
                        ).Magnitude

                    if distance
                        < bestDistance then

                        bestDistance =
                            distance

                        best = node
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

local function nextHotspot(profile)
    local parts = profile.Parts

    if #parts == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local state =
        getIslandState(
            profile.Island
        )

    local now = os.clock()

    for _ = 1,#parts do
        state.Cursor += 1

        if state.Cursor > #parts then
            state.Cursor = 1
        end

        local part =
            parts[state.Cursor]

        local failed =
            state.FailedParts[part]

        if part.Parent
            and (
                not failed
                or now >= failed
            ) then

            return part
        end
    end

    return
        parts[
            RNG:NextInteger(
                1,
                #parts
            )
        ]
end

local function nearestZone(profile)
    local hrp = root()

    if not hrp then
        return nil
    end

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        if insidePart(
            part,
            hrp.Position,
            1
        ) then

            return part
        end
    end

    local nearest
    local nearestDistance = math.huge

    for _,part in ipairs(
        profile.Parts
    ) do
        local distance =
            (
                hrp.Position
                - part.Position
            ).Magnitude

        if distance < nearestDistance then
            nearestDistance = distance
            nearest = part
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

local function tryDig(timeout)
    CandidateLock =
        os.clock() + 1.05

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    resetDigEquipment()

    local started = os.clock()

    repeat
        if isDigging() then
            CandidateLock =
                os.clock() + 1.5

            return true
        end

        digClick()

        task.wait(0.012)

    until not alive()
        or os.clock() - started
        > (timeout or 0.65)

    local grace = os.clock()

    repeat
        if isDigging() then
            CandidateLock =
                os.clock() + 1.5

            return true
        end

        task.wait(0.006)

    until not alive()
        or os.clock() - grace > 0.18

    CandidateLock = 0

    return false
end

local function tryNode(profile,node)
    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        node.position,
        profile
    ) then

        FailedNodes[node.id] =
            os.clock() + 0.7

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.035)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    if tryDig(0.65) then
        return true
    end

    FailedNodes[node.id] =
        os.clock() + 0.75

    return false
end

local function tryHotspot(profile,part)
    if not part
        or not part.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local point =
        randomPointInPart(
            part,
            0.3
        )

    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        point,
        profile
    ) then

        getIslandState(
            profile.Island
        ).FailedParts[part] =
            os.clock() + 0.35

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.03)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    if tryDig(0.6) then
        return true
    end

    getIslandState(
        profile.Island
    ).FailedParts[part] =
        os.clock() + 0.4

    return false
end

local function tryZone(profile,part)
    if not part
        or not part.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local point =
        randomPointInPart(
            part,
            0.1
        )

    if not teleportGround(
        profile.Island,
        point,
        profile
    ) then

        return false
    end

    setDetectorHeld(true)

    task.wait(0.025)

    setDetectorHeld(false)

    return tryDig(0.38)
end

local function searchDig(
    oneTest,
    island
)
    if not alive()
        or Searching
        or Busy
        or isDigging() then

        return false
    end

    island =
        island or ActiveIsland

    if not island
        or not island.Parent then

        return false
    end

    local profile =
        getIslandProfile(
            island
        )

    if #profile.Parts == 0 then
        notify(
            island.Name,
            "No DigArea parts found"
        )

        return false
    end

    Searching = true

    local found = false

    while alive()
        and (
            oneTest
            or (
                Settings.AutoFarm
                and Settings.AutoDig
                and ActiveIsland == island
            )
        ) do

        if Busy or isDigging() then
            found = isDigging()
            break
        end

        local node =
            getNearestNodeForProfile(
                profile
            )

        if node then
            if tryNode(
                profile,
                node
            ) then

                found = true
                break
            end

        elseif profile.Mode == "Hotspots" then
            local hotspot =
                nextHotspot(
                    profile
                )

            if hotspot
                and tryHotspot(
                    profile,
                    hotspot
                ) then

                found = true
                break
            end

        else
            local zone =
                nearestZone(
                    profile
                )

            if zone
                and tryZone(
                    profile,
                    zone
                ) then

                found = true
                break
            end
        end

        task.wait(0.005)
    end

    Searching = false

    return found
end

local function sellAll()
    if Busy then
        return
    end

    Busy = true

    local returnPosition =
        savePosition()

    local snapshot =
        inventoryEntries()

    local sold = 0
    local protected = 0
    local failed = 0

    for _,original in ipairs(snapshot) do
        if not alive() then
            break
        end

        local item =
            findInventory(
                original.uid,
                refreshData()
            )

        if not item then
            continue
        end

        if item.pedestalSlot ~= nil then
            continue
        end

        if item.favorited == true then
            protected += 1
            continue
        end

        local success,reason =
            sellUid(
                item.uid
            )

        if success then
            sold += 1

        elseif reason == "favorited" then
            protected += 1

        else
            failed += 1
        end

        task.wait(0.04)
    end

    restorePosition(
        returnPosition
    )

    resetDigEquipment()

    Busy = false

    notify(
        "Sell All",
        "Sold "
        .. tostring(sold)
        .. " | Protected "
        .. tostring(protected)
        .. " | Failed "
        .. tostring(failed)
    )
end

local function tp(cf)
	local c = lp.Character
	if not c then return end
	local hr = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if hr then hr.CFrame = cf end
end

local function tpObj(names, offset)
	offset = offset or Vector3.new(0, 5, 4)
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		local o = Workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if o then
			local p
			if o:IsA("Model") and o.PrimaryPart then p = o.PrimaryPart.Position
			elseif o:IsA("BasePart") then p = o.Position
			else
				local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
				if h then p = h.Position end
			end
			if p then tp(CFrame.new(p + offset)) return end
		end
	end
	warn("[TP] Not found: " .. names[1])
end
